Kristin — thanks for the redlines, I reviewed the PDF and made inline comments. A couple of clarifying points from Legal: 

• UK IDTA / UK Addendum: Redwood is willing to execute the UK IDTA in parallel. Our standard approach is to attach the UK Addendum as a schedule so signature can be simultaneous; if Fathom prefers a standalone IDTA we can do that but it may require a short review.

• SCCs (EU): we implement the EU 2021 SCCs in our DPA as the fallback transfer mechanism. In cases where customers have Dedicated/Private deployments, we also offer Contractual Transfer Impact Assessments (CTI / TIA) and can include operational mitigations in an annex.

• Subprocessors: attached is the current export (CSV) with country and access type. Note: we classify access types as "hosting/model-serving" vs "observability/logs" — please flag any vendor you want more detail on.

• KMS/HSM: for Hosted customers the default is Redwood-managed AWS KMS (us-west-2). For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed KMS and HSMs (BYOK) — we can document the integration steps in the TIA.

• Logs & Retention: default 90 days for full request/response; 365 days for aggregated telemetry. We can offer custom retention via contract for enterprise plans; masking is applied at ingestion for known PII patterns but customers should avoid sending sensitive identifiers in free-text prompts.

Requested items from Fathom to finish the TIA:
1) A short list of data categories (examples: user prompts, inferred PII, identifiers).
2) Confirmation whether you require BYOK/HSM for this project.
3) Any mandatory subprocessor exclusions.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_map_20261005.csv, redwood_dataflow_20261005.png

If that addresses the redlines at a high level, we can propose contract language for Sections 6–9 (transfers, subprocessors, security) and push for signature within 10 business days.

—Lauren Bishop
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

> For the subprocessor map: can you add a column indicating whether subprocessors have access to request/response content vs only metadata/metrics?
- Yes — we've added an "access_type_detailed" column to the master CSV and uploaded a new version to the secure share. I'll send that file link to your legal inbox separately (we avoid putting full lists in email for security).

> Evidence for masking: do you have a short technical note or runbook we can attach as evidence showing PII masking at ingestion?
- Vivek will share a short runbook (1–2 pages) that explains ingestion filters and redaction heuristics. Expect that by EOD tomorrow.

Such assistance shall be provided within a commercially reasonable timeframe following Controller's written request." Feel free to propose edits; Legal can formalize.
